articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Infect 5,600 Devices With Stealthy Malware That Hides Remote-Control Commands in Normal Traffic
articles.summary:
A new variant of the Cling botnet has infected about 5,600 devices. It hides its command-and-control (C&C) traffic inside ordinary STUN exchanges, which makes it hard to spot. China’s CNCERT reported the spread in November 2026. The botnet mainly targets Linux servers and IoT devices. STUN helps devices behind a NAT discover their public address […]

articles.title: Windows NTLM Security Update Causes Authentication Failures in Third-Party Apps and Devices
articles.summary:

Affected products can include authentication proxy servers, single sign-on (SSO) solutions, and application packaging tools. Microsoft documented the issue in KB5135557 after rolling out […]

articles.title: Hackers Actively Exploit Critical Drupal Vulnerability to Take Over Websites

articles.title: Critical GeoServer Vulnerability Chain Lets Hackers Execute Remote Commands Without Authentication
articles.summary:
Five vulnerabilities in GeoServer, an open-source server for publishing geospatial data, can be chained to execute operating system commands without valid credentials. Security researcher CryptoCat demonstrated the chain on a default Linux installation, while watchTowr reported seeing attempts to exploit two of the flaws in its honeypot network. The observations show attackers probing exposed servers, […]

articles.title: Hackers Poison GitHub Pull Requests With Malware That Can Steal Developer Passwords
articles.summary:
A threat actor used rewritten commits in open GitHub pull requests to deliver the PolinRider credential-stealing loader. It targeted AsyncAPI Generator, CircuitVerse and Open Food Facts. None of the account’s 145 merged pull requests carries the loader, but CircuitVerse’s CI ran it and published 40 infected installers. On November 25, AsyncAPI Generator maintainer Lukasz Gornicki […]

articles.title: Critical Danfoss Refrigeration Controller Vulnerability Could Let Hackers Execute Arbitrary Code Remotely
articles.summary:

The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-129713, affects software version 5.4.0 and earlier. articles.title: FIFA Confirms Data Breach After Hackers Steal Personal and Business Information
articles.summary:
